name: fld_gaussianInt_isUnit_iff
statement: (z : GaussianInt) : IsUnit z ↔ z = 1 ∨ z = -1 ∨ z = ⟨0, 1⟩ ∨ z = ⟨0, -1⟩
closed: ∀ (z : GaussianInt), IsUnit z ↔ z = 1 ∨ z = -1 ∨ z = ⟨0, 1⟩ ∨ z = ⟨0, -1⟩
informal: The units of ℤ[i] are exactly 1, -1, i, -i — by Zsqrtd.norm_eq_one_iff' a unit has norm re^2 + im^2 = 1, forcing (re, im) ∈ {(±1, 0), (0, ±1)}; the converse is a direct check.
type: ∀ (z : GaussianInt), IsUnit z ↔ z = 1 ∨ z = -1 ∨ z = { re := 0, im := 1 } ∨ z = { re := 0, im := -1 }
